name: Toyota BIN Inspector
description: Read-only identification and inspection of Toyota ECU BIN files using source-derived size and byte-pattern profiles. Reports raw observations for speed, RPM and cut-off regions without modifying ECU data.

capabilities.description: Identify a Toyota vehicle/profile candidate from BIN size and source byte patterns. Reports ambiguity rather than guessing.
Inspect a supported Toyota BIN and return profile, SHA-256, speed bytes, RPM observation and cut-off region observations.
Read-only inspection of the source-defined speed data region and its raw bytes.
Read-only inspection of the source-defined RPM region between its pattern delimiters.
Read-only inspection of the source-defined cut-off region and observed words.
